primary_task: Write Playwright page-object E2E tests for a frontend task's acceptance criteria and run them in a real browser against a local dev server.

requirements.name: @playwright/test (npm package)
requirements.evidence: "import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'"; 'npx playwright test playwright-tests/[feature-name].spec.ts'
requirements.basis: bash: 'install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu ...)'

requirements.name: real browser binary (Chromium via playwright install)
requirements.evidence: 'Verifies acceptance criteria in a real browser'; 'verify real user flows in a real browser'
requirements.basis: Playwright downloads browsers from its own CDN, not an open host: 'only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example ... Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare'. The manifest states no preinstalled browser.

requirements.name: local dev server of the project
requirements.evidence: 'Running local dev server (started via the project's standard dev command)'
requirements.basis: bash: 'start and stop local servers inside the session'

requirements.name: state.json, orchestrator-output.md, AGENTS.md in the working directory
requirements.evidence: '.claude/pipeline/orchestrator-output.md - acceptance criteria to verify in browser'
requirements.basis: tools.read: 'read files in the working directory'; presence not stated.

notes: The browser is the decider. If the session image has a preinstalled Chromium or Playwright browsers (the manifest does not say), the verdict would be ACHIEVABLE. If task_type is BACKEND the skill exits at once, which would be trivially achievable; I labelled the FRONTEND case the skill is for.
